column1: # SyMoNeuRaL port registry -- THE source of truth for every listening port on this box.
# Hand-maintained. Four consumers read it and none of them hardcodes a port:
#   tools/build_ports.py       -> ops/registry/PORTS.md          (generated, do not hand-edit)
#   backend/apps/ports.py      -> the API and every surface process
#   ops/symoneural-surface@.service (via the per-instance env file it generates)
#   tools/smoke.py             -> which port to test each surface on
# Why a TSV and not the Markdown table: `ops/Caddyfile`, the unit template and the rack all
# need this machine-readable, and this repository has already been bitten by a figure that
# lived only in prose. The Markdown is the rendering, not the record.
# SERVICE     the systemd unit or process that binds it
# PORT        the TCP port
# BIND        127.0.0.1 = loopback only; 0.0.0.0 = every interface (say why in NOTE)
# SURFACE     the /api/status unit id this port serves, or "-" if it is not a surface
# DELEGATED   yes = a split-out process owns this surface and backend/api.py must NOT
#             register its inline route. no = the monolith still answers it.
#             Flipping this to yes without the process running takes the surface down --
#             which is why `backend/apps/ports.py` refuses to report a surface delegated
#             unless the registry ALSO gives it a port.
# STATE       running | proposed | external
# NOTE        why it exists, and anything an operator needs before touching it
SERVICE
symoneural-web
symoneural-web
column7: Caddy. Public HTTPS. Site block is symoneural.com/www only -- there is no localhost site, so https://localhost returns 000 and that is not a fault.

column1: symoneural-web
column7: Caddy admin API. No `admin` directive in the Caddyfile, so this is on by default. A `reload` pushes config through it.

column1: symoneural-gateway
column7: symon-gateway. Forwards /api/{*path} and /v1/* verbatim to the API. Enabled 2026-09-09; it being stopped was the five-day 502.

column1: symoneural-api
column7: backend/api.py. The monolith: every surface not marked DELEGATED above answers here.

column1: symoneural-llm
column7: llama-server, started by the API under a governor lease. Not an independent unit.

column1: symoneural-ui
column7: ComfyUI. Hand-started by scripts/symoneural-ui.sh; nothing starts it at boot, and studio reporting offline until then is correct.

column1: symoneural-ravencalc
column7: THE PILOT. Its own uvicorn: backend/apps/ravencalc/service.py. DELEGATED stays `no` until the unit is installed -- flipping it first would 404 the surface on the live monolith.

column1: sshd
column7: OpenSSH on a non-standard port. PermitRootLogin no, fail2ban active. Not first-party; recorded because public exposure is an open question.

column1: xrdp
column7: xrdp (/etc/xrdp/xrdp.ini). Not first-party; same reason as sshd.
